SELECT summary.source_bill_no AS sourceBillNo, summary.line_count AS lineCount, summary.source_modify_time AS sourceModifyTime, summary.last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, summary.production_order_count AS productionOrderCount, summary.production_order_summary AS productionOrderSummary FROM ( SELECT base.source_bill_no, COUNT(*) AS line_count, MAX(base.source_modify_time) AS source_modify_time, MAX(base.last_sync_time) AS last_sync_time, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(base.production_order_no, '')) AS production_order_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(base.production_order_no, '') ORDER BY base.production_order_no SEPARATOR '、') AS production_order_summary FROM mes_kingdee_production_material_list base WHERE base.deleted = 0 GROUP BY base.source_bill_no ) summary WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_kingdee_production_material_list matched WHERE matched.deleted = 0 AND matched.source_bill_no = summary.source_bill_no
)
mapper.select: ORDER BY summary.source_modify_time DESC, summary.last_sync_time DESC, summary.source_bill_no DESC
ORDER BY summary.source_modify_time DESC, summary.last_sync_time DESC, summary.source_bill_no DESC
